page.layout: Single column of running text on one printed page. Running head across the top with the page number at the right. A level-2 heading "2. BONIFACIVS quartus." sits between the two paragraphs. A catchword is at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: [?]ta Platinam atq; alios scriptores: Volumus ac mandamus, statuimus ac praecipimus: dumq; esset, non Ecclesiae, sed aquilae alterum caput, penes vaticinale somnium Esdrae. Sic propter populi peccata, hypocritam regnare fecit Deus, Iob 34. Constituit in sua superbia post Phocam, ut Rom. sedes ceteris omnibus deinceps anteferretur, habita Episcoporum synodo: & ne quis sub anathematis poena, in locum demortui pontificis surrogaretur, nisi tertia saltem post obitum eius die: & ne largitione aut gratia quis Pontificatum ambiret, quā vis ipse prius id fecerit. Voluit item pontificis electionem a clero pariter & populo fieri: sed id non diu durauit, interposita hac clausula, Volumus & iubemus. Ab hoc tempore caelestis doctrinae puritas in Ecclesia euanuit, ac valde est crescentibus superstitionibus obscurata. 2 Thes 2. Bonifacius iste anno Domini 607. nondum expleto Pontificatus anno, rebus humanis excessit.
main_text.head: 2. BONIFACIVS quartus.
main_text.p: Bonifacius quartus, è Valeria Marforum urbe, Pantheon fœdissimum falsorum deorum templum, à Cæsare Phoca impetrauit, ut in eo, Cybelis spurcissimæ deorum matris loco, Maria Christi seruatoris mater, cum martyribus sanctis colerentur, Horrenda certè mutatio, & cum D. Pauli do

page.notes: Catchword doubtful: the word at the lower right is partly visible and read as "ḡrina" with [?]; the word is probably "doctrina". "xta" at the top is a fragment of an earlier word (probably "ista"), left uncertain. "quā vis" is doubtful (possibly "quamuis"). "Thes" is partly unclear. "fœdissimum" and "Cybelis" were read with some doubt. Show-through and blurred marks at the foot of the page are not transcribed.
